name: Amaeda Chiwa
source:
A girl whom Kento meets on his school trip and also his cousin's best friend. One year later, because of their parents' remarriage, they reunite and become step-siblings. Because of her petite appearance and cheerful personality, she is adored by everyone around her. She is in love with Kento due to his "kindness", and tries to win him over, no matter the cost.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1206724]Getchu[/url]]
